reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Presiding judge appointment of secretarial and administrative staff
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes presiding judge of each circuit to appoint secretarial and administrative staff serving at judge's pleasure.

headings.title: Establishment of staff salaries and state or federal funding requirement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that staff salaries and numbers are fixed by presiding judge within state or federal funding, barring county funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and 22nd Circuit v. City of St. Louis (619 S.W.2d 330) annotation on presiding judge staff appointments and state/federal funding.

headings.title: Mandatory appointment of certified official court reporter by circuit judge
headings.reviewNote: Requires each circuit judge to appoint a sworn certified court reporter holding office during the judge's pleasure.

headings.title: Part-time reporters and electronic record preservation in probate divisions
headings.reviewNote: Permits circuit judges serving probate divisions to use part-time reporters or electronic record systems.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections requiring certified official court reporters for circuit judges and permitting part-time reporters or section 478.072 preservation in probate divisions.

headings.title: Temporary transfer of court reporter upon transfer of circuit judge
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court upon written notice from a transferred circuit judge to order temporary reporter transfer if regular reporter is unavailable and transfer is deemed necessary (*"the" omitted in original rolls).

headings.title: Temporary transfer of reporter during illness or incapacity of regular reporter
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes supreme court to temporarily transfer an official reporter to cover for an ill or incapacitated reporter.

headings.title: Presiding judge assignment of reporter to another division during judge absence
headings.reviewNote: Empowers presiding judge in multi-judge circuits to assign an absent judge's reporter to another division.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections and original-rolls footnote (*"the" omitted) on temporary transfers of court reporters and presiding judge reassignment during judge absence.

headings.title: Historical statutory salary schedule for circuit court reporters
headings.reviewNote: Sets historical baseline annual salaries of twenty-six thousand nine hundred dollars and thirty thousand dollars.

headings.title: Annual salary adjustments under judicial compensation plan
headings.reviewNote: Applies annual judicial salary adjustments under section 476.405 to court reporter compensation.

headings.title: Experience-based step salary schedule for cumulative years of service
headings.reviewNote: Establishes tiered salary adjustments based on cumulative years of court reporting service beginning in 2022.

headings.title: Monthly or semimonthly salary installments upon judicial certification
headings.reviewNote: Requires equal monthly salary installments upon employing judge certification, or semimonthly or monthly installments as designated by commissioner of administration when paid by the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections and Appendix D salary index note; replaced inaccurate subsection 4 heading to match monthly/semimonthly installment payments on judicial certification.

headings.title: Mandatory certified court reporter appointment and temporary limit
headings.reviewNote: Bars appointing uncertified official court reporters under Rule 14, permitting temporary appointment during absence for no more than six months without certification.

headings.title: Certified reporter requirement for in-state depositions in proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Bars using in-state deposition testimony in Missouri courts or administrative appeals unless prepared and certified by a certified court reporter, except under Rule 57.03(c).

headings.title: Conformity of out-of-state depositions certified by authorized reporters
headings.reviewNote: Deems out-of-state deposition testimony compliant if prepared and certified by a court reporter authorized in the jurisdiction where taken.

headings.title: Exemption for in-state depositions in non-Missouri pending cases
headings.reviewNote: Exempts in-state depositions taken for cases not pending in a Missouri state court or administrative agency at the time taken.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections; replaced all 4 completely mismatched draft headings (which erroneously described circuit court marshals) with certified court reporter and deposition certification provisions.
